caption:
The water board's survey arrives by mail.

It goes to operating facilities. State law requires a reply. The Texas Tribune's records count 334 data center facilities from 2020 through 2025. 233 never sent one back. Skipping it is a Class C misdemeanor. The Tribune puts the fine at up to $500. The board says it can't prosecute. State officials don't know whether any penalty has been issued.

Data centers not yet switched on now answer to the grid operator.

ERCOT's September 14th notice carries the water board's questions. The developer's own utility files each notarized answer. Silence is reported to the PUC and the Office of the Governor. The request reaches projects not yet energized.

The deck drills a bore for each facility and plugs the ones that answered.

ERCOT expects a report with the PUC by December 10th. Will it say who answered?

#ERCOT #TWDB #TexasWater

c29 The Tribune reports 233 of those facilities never submitted a requested survey. https://www.texastribune.org/2026/10/14/texas-data-centers-water-use-penalties-enforcement/

c32 The Tribune reports the water board says it has no authority of its own to prosecute violations. https://www.texastribune.org/2026/10/14/texas-data-centers-water-use-penalties-enforcement/

c12 ERCOT coordinated with the PUC and the Texas Water Development Board to develop the Section C questions. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01
c14 The water board's Executive Administrator authorized ERCOT to issue the Section C questions on the board's behalf. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01
c21 Each transmission or distribution service provider files the RFI in RIOO for the data center developer. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01

c4 The request reaches developers of proposed data centers with a peak requested load of at least 25 MW and under 75 MW. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01
c7 Batch Zero facilities are covered only if not yet energized at transmission voltage of 60 kV or above. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01
c25 ERCOT will coordinate with the PUC on a report of conclusions from its review. https://www.ercot.com/services/comm/mkt_notices/M-B091426-01

why_this_opening: The survey is literally a form that comes in the mail, and a form you can leave on the counter is the most physical way to show why 233 never came back. That sets up the turn, where the next answers come notarized through the developer's own utility.
